name: Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr
benefit:
> ***Financial Benefits***

- Onetime remuneration as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa to the artiste to be documented.
- Additional amount as decided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for artistes living outside Goa.
- Remuneration to the interviewer as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.

> ***Non-Financial Benefits***

- Video recording of artiste's experiences on High Definition or higher format
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a veteran artist who has contributed to the development of Tiatr. - The applicant must be a script writer, director, actor, singer, musician, backstage artiste involved in stage setting, light effects, background music, costumes, make-up, or those involved in organizing tiatrs. - The applicant must have made at least 20 years of contribution to the Konkani stage. - The applicant who is a writer or director must have scripted at least 15 tiatrs. - The applicant who is other than writer or director must have participated in at least 20 tiatrs. > ***Preference, Selection and Implementation*** - At least five artistes will be considered for documentation in a financial year. - Artistes will be selected by the Managing Committee of Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Preference will be given to old and sick artistes.
